description: Call this tool to make a QR code that joins a WiFi network when scanned: ssid, password and auth type, written to out_path or returned as SVG. Free: 20 codes a month. qr_create takes plain text or a URL.

auth.description: WPA (default when a password is given), WEP, or nopass for an open network

error_correction.description: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

hidden.description: True if the network does not broadcast its name

margin.description: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-code. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; a PNG always comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name already produced in this request (default false)

password.description: Passphrase. Leave out only for an open network

size.description: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

ssid.description: Network name, exactly as it appears

name: qr_wifi
title: WiFi QR code
